title: Total degree of the affine inverse coordinate polynomial
statement: Let $K$ be a field, fix an element $\omega \in K$, and let $n$ be a natural number with a distinguished coordinate index $i \in \{0,\dots,n-1\}$. The polynomial $1 + \omega^{-1} - \omega^{-1} X_i$ in the polynomial ring $K[X_0,\dots,X_{n-1}]$ has total degree at most $1$.
hypotheses_covered: ω is a fixed element of K
i is a coordinate index in Fin n
replaced: The total degree of $\mathrm{affineInvPoly}\,\omega\,i$ is at most $1$.
